# State Class View (variant): Ecologist (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Ecologist (`emst:core/ROL-BMJ0VB9`, P2); authority position (editorial): advisor-researcher
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.3.0, rule state-class-view@0.2.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped at skos:closeMatch or stronger in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Assess and monitor biodiversity across species and habitats — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Recognize and assess ecosystems that have crossed into novel states — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Plan for ecological transformation with resist, accept or direct strategies — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Assess climate vulnerability of species, ecosystems, infrastructure and communities — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Build, calibrate and validate predictive and simulation models of environmental systems — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess ecosystem services with production-function models validated against observations — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Plan for non-analog ecological futures — senior L3, lead L4
- Plan assisted migration and managed relocation of species and genotypes — senior L3, lead L4
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
